sources.role: Sony original CECHA00 front/rear layout, control separation, connector order and side
Evan-Amos firsthand photograph, 2016-08-19, CECHA01 same launch shell family; confirms rear vent pattern and relative interface heights, not Japanese labels
Original reverse-engineering AV MULTI twelve-position single-row topology, consistent with the photograph; compatible family reference only
Manufacturer compatible HDMI Type A interface drawing; 19 positions, 15 x 5.65 mm sleeve; not identified as Sony OEM connector
Manufacturer eight-position RJ45 interface, nominal 1.02 mm contact pitch; not identified as Sony OEM part

changes: Rear HDMI, LAN, optical, AV MULTI and AC moved from the incorrect side to negative model X, matching the right side of a rear view.
Data interface heights separated from the lower AC inlet; native shell cutters and master switch follow.
Two six-column horizontal vent banks replace the two-row vertical vent bank; left outer column omits two lower slots.
Power and eject touch positions separated along X; sensing packages/electrodes and illustrative board envelope follow.
AV MULTI changes from 6+6 contacts to twelve in one row; sleeve and tongue reduced to match existing accessory plug.
HDMI Type A sleeve and nominal pitch updated; Ethernet spring pitch reduced from 1.34 to 1.02 mm.
Three AC harness routes and existing board/shield cut tools follow relocated inlet.
Rear closure skirt extended to the hood underside to mask the former open gap.
One illustrative rear fastening stack and its three board/shield clearances move inward to avoid the relocated AC inlet; upper-shield control-board opening follows separated sensors.

estimated_dimensions.basis: Centre coordinates are photo/manual fits calibrated by the published body envelope. AV pitch follows the existing study plug; contact thickness, depth, shell profiles, vent sizes and control board are estimated.

remaining_limitations: No factory shell, motherboard, optical-drive or controller dimensional CAD verified.
Rear photograph depicts CECHA01; local labels and regional markings are not copied to the CECHA00 study.
Accessory AV plug models the twelve-position compatible envelope; original composite cable population and electrical wiring are not reproduced.
Local casing curvature, graphics, internal electronics and cable lengths remain approximate.
